brand.title: About Us
brand.description: Yurucheng is dedicated to bringing Chinese jade culture to global consumers through modern design and cross-border e-commerce.
brand.positioningDescription: We focus on 'quality jade for young buyers', designing products for three main scenarios: gifting, daily wear, and light collection. Through modern visual expression and cross-border social media, we lower the barriers to understanding and purchasing traditional jade.
brand.cultureDescription: Through content-driven storytelling, we explain jade symbolism, carving techniques, and cultural origins to help overseas consumers understand Chinese jade culture. The project actively engages youth in intangible cultural heritage craftsmanship.
brand.industryDescription: Through coordinated design, content, sales, and fulfillment, we connect raw materials, processing, and marketing to enhance supply chain digitalization. We collaborate with local businesses to create related job opportunities.
brand.readyToShopDescription: Start with scenario-based shopping, then explore the content hub for styling and buying tips.

content.description: Content and shopping are our twin engines. Every article is linked to related products, shortening the path from inspiration to purchase.
